description: Open a NEW project when the work at hand has no home in Arroway; it needs slug, name and scope. Propose the name and scope to the person FIRST and call only once they agree. update=true renames a project you own and rewrites its scope, when the person asks or the scope is wrong; the slug stays. invite brings a person into the project at slug, when the person wants them in.

invite.description: Email of a person to bring in; name and scope not needed. Returns a checkout link if a team plan is needed.

scope.description: What belongs here and what does not: the subject AND what is out.

update.description: true: change name and scope of the existing project at slug.

name: arroway_start_project
title: Open a new project
